name: HUMAN MADE Inc.
summary: HUMAN MADE Inc. sells apparel and lifestyle products in Japan. The company offers mugs, caps, bags, containers, rugs, shoes, t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, sweaters, denim jackets, down jackets, oxford shirts, work shirts, denim, chinos, and cargo pants; and interior goods and towels. It sells its products under the HUMAN MADE, Buffer, and CURRY UP brands through e-commerce and retail channels. HUMAN MADE Inc. was formerly known as Otsumo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HUMAN MADE Inc. in May 2024. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.
